note: Why the legislative files and Voteview record a senator's vote differently. A difference with no entry here is shown on the site as unresolved.

entries.explanation: By unanimous consent on February 4, 2025, the Senate let Senator Padilla change this vote from nay to aye, since it would not affect the outcome. The original count was 79 to 18, and the corrected count is 80 to 17. Voteview shows the original.

source.title: Congressional Record, Daily Digest, February 4, 2025, page D112
